814.body:

Harden Shepherd local-model admission to exact loopback HTTP origins, refuse redirects, and prove redirect denial against an executed source/target fixture. Focused Runtime tests, strict clippy, formatting, diff hygiene, and the Runtime owner lane pass. Independent exact-head rereview passed after both initial P2 findings were resolved.

819.body:
Closes #819

Part of #522

## Outcome

Reconciles all 152 retained C-SDLC v3 review rows against frozen candidate `fb6cbc7f619daa54f901fd2d12f480add682ace3`. The 51 source-supported rows are joined to complete candidate execution and exact candidate evidence. Each of the remaining 101 non-proving rows carries a criterion-specific, digest-bound proposal to remove only that criterion from the v0.92.1 retained release gate.

## Truth boundary

- No non-proving row is promoted to a behavioral pass.
- The 101 removal proposals remain `pending_operator_review`.
- `release_ready` remains `false` before merge.
- Merging this PR is explicit operator approval of the exact proposal digests; it does not claim the associated product behavior was implemented or removed.

## Validation

- 152/152 rows unique and reconciled: 51 candidate-executed, 101 exact removal proposals, 0 unclassified
- complete 211-test C-SDLC v3 suite passed
- all-target C-SDLC v3 clippy passed
- current V3-A contract validator passed
- 18/18 adversarial receipt and authority mutations rejected
- native six-card validation passed at generation 11 / digest `b3a4982498b2991d3aee1ac455a0c3b0a5b10aaa12bbbe69edc60f22810460df`
